pin_method: All 240 frames; three-dimensional Euclidean distance relative to f0 AND maximum pairwise distance; tolerance 0.5 mm. Raw foot contact centroid and ankle joint fields measured independently of empty spec.qa.pins.
cyan_method: G>R+25 && B>R+25 && min(G,B)>100; readability proxy, not muscle activity or anatomical coverage
known_visual_issue: Hark accepted possible cyan occlusion during forward hinge, provided upright f0 and f220 show hip highlight. No radius or engine change made.

left.interpretation: Raw observed joint angle; no exact 90-degree acceptance threshold added.

right.interpretation: Raw observed joint angle; no exact 90-degree acceptance threshold added.
